lines.en: I head to the soccer field first thing in the morning and immediately make my way over to Karin.
lines.zh: 我一大早就去了足球场，径直朝 Karin 走去。

lines.en: She questions why I'm spending my time with {i}her{/i} rather than Miku, so I make up some excuse about how important co-captains are.
lines.zh: 她问我为什么把时间花在{i}她{/i}身上而不是 Miku，我就胡扯了个借口，说共同队长有多重要。

lines.en: I'm not sure how true that statement is, but she seems really happy to hear it and her face lights up in response.
lines.zh: 我不确定这话有多少是真的，但她听起来非常开心，整张脸都亮了起来。

lines.en: It's irresistibly cute seeing someone who appears to be so tomboyish acting so...girly whenever something makes her happy.
lines.zh: 看一个看起来这么男孩子气的人，一遇到开心的事就露出这么……女孩子的神态，真是可爱得让人顶不住。

lines.en: And even though the two of us aren't as close as can be yet, I'm still glad to be able to see that side of her...
lines.zh: 虽然我们俩还没有亲近到那种程度，但能看到她这一面，我还是很高兴……

lines.en: I hang around for a few hours and watch the girls play a practice game or two.
lines.zh: 我待了几个小时，看她们打了一两场练习赛。

lines.en: Karin and Miku are the clear standouts among everyone, and it comes as no surprise knowing that they're the ones basically running things.
lines.zh: Karin 和 Miku 在所有人里明显出类拔萃，一想到基本是她俩在操持整支队伍，也就不足为奇了。

lines.en: Eventually, practice comes to an end and I have to gather my things and leave while the girls head back inside the[school] get changed...
lines.zh: 训练终于结束，我得收拾东西离开，女孩们则回[school]里面换衣服……
